statements.text: Before your first question, we ask once whether this site may send questions onward. Your question is not sent beyond this site before you answer. Allow: your question is sent to the model service. A data source is used only if it is On, or if it is set to Ask first and you allow it when asked. Don't allow: nothing is sent. You are asked again when you send a question. You can set each data source to On, Ask first or Off in Data source settings at any time. After you withdraw consent, we send no questions until you agree again. Withdrawing cannot take back a question already sent.
We keep your answer in a cookie, named below, until this browser session ends.
The consent cookie is named civic-source-consent . It holds your choices and the versions of this statement they refer to, never who you are.
To withdraw consent, open Data source settings.

Your answer covers the list of recipients as it was when you answered. We ask again when a recipient changes in a way your answer may not cover. For example: a recipient is added, a recipient says it keeps more, or a source moves to a different host.
A recipient may also be removed, or say it keeps less. Your answer is kept in a cookie, so we may ask again instead.

For each recipient, we state what it says it keeps, and for how long when it gives a time. Where it says so on a page, we give that page and the date we read it. If a provider says nothing, we write "not stated." Nobody, including this site, can check a hosted service's logging from outside. That is why there is another option. You can also run this whole system on your own computer, with your own model and data sources.
This site does not name a deployment guide.
